General Information
NEW in the Original Packaging
Stocked & Shipped From – LEXINGTON, KY
What is This Part?
This part is the OEM Lower Windshield Frame Rubber Seal.
This part attaches to the Lower part of the Windshield Frame and seals the Windshield frame to the body.
Comes with pre-applied adhesive backing.
Direct Replacement
What Will I Receive?
Qty 1 – Lower Windshield Rubber Seal
What Vehicle Will This Fit?
Suzuki Samurai 1985 – 1995 All Models
Suzuki SJ410 1980 – 1984 All Models
